capabilities: Open a pre-selected note via a configurable hotkey
Open the selected note from a ribbon button or command
Choose the target note from a searchable list of vault Markdown files
Warn with a red ribbon icon and notice when the selected note is missing
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not create daily notes; it only opens one fixed note chosen in settings.
extras: Not yet published in the Obsidian community plugin directory and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; manual installation from repository files is described. Intended platforms are macOS and iOS, with platform checks still needing release validation. An earlier plugin ID (daily-note-key-plugin) is not migrated automatically.
motivation: The author uses a "today" note that is always the same file, which daily notes do not provide since they create date-based notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in single shortcut or ribbon button that opens one fixed, pre-chosen note; finding a specific file each day requires the switcher or bookmarks.
summary: Ribbon button and configurable hotkey that open one pre-selected Markdown note in the vault, such as a fixed "today" note.
